label: 02 · Piece Reel
description: Your own clips cut into a Reel, the words never over the piece: two to five clips, each in its own rect with the piece's name and one line of detail under it, the hook above the first, then a closing card - where to buy, or where to find you at a show, with an optional show band under every clip. The clip holds still through every crossfade. Every clip edits on the canvas: drop a clip or a photo in, drag the area it fills; one fit for all of them. With no clips of your own, real ones from the starter pack stand in, never clip art.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Where the reel is going: story 9:16 by default - Reels, TikTok, Stories; feed 4:5 and square 1:1 re-flow; landscape 16:9 and email 2:1 put the clip on the left and the words on the right. Sets the canvas when the resolution is left locked to the template.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark above every clip and large on the closing card. A logo replaces it on the closing card. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo for the closing card: an image or a short muted looping video. Empty draws the brand name.

brandLogoRegion.label: Brand logo area
brandLogoRegion.description: Where the logo goes - or the brand name, when there is no logo - drawn on the preview: drag the rect to move it, pull a corner to resize it. Empty keeps its place in the layout.

brandLogoFit.label: Brand logo fit
brandLogoFit.description: contain shows the whole logo inside its area; cover fills the area and crops the logo's edges. Default: contain.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.description: Small caps under the wordmark on the closing card. Empty removes it.

hook.label: Hook
hook.description: The opening line, above the first clip - the thumbnail. Empty removes it.

secondsPerClip.label: Seconds per clip
secondsPerClip.description: How long each clip holds the frame, 2 to 8. The closing card holds half a second longer (3 to 6). A pinned duration scales every slot instead.

clip1.label: Clip 1
clip1.description: A clip or a photo of the first piece, in its own rect - nothing is ever drawn over it. A clip shorter than its step loops, muted. Empty shows a starter clip from the pack until you add yours.

clip1Region.label: Clip 1 area
clip1Region.description: Where the clip goes, drawn on the preview: drag the rect to move it, pull a corner to resize it - the clip fills the rect at the reel's Clip fit, so a tighter rect crops it. Empty keeps its place in the layout.

clip1Label.label: Clip 1 name
clip1Label.description: The piece's name, under the clip - the stone and the shape are what a buyer looks for. A step with neither a clip nor a name is dropped.

clip1Detail.label: Clip 1 detail
clip1Detail.description: One quiet line under the name: metal, carat, cut. Empty removes it.
clip1Detail.placeholder: Two solitaires, just off the bench

clip1Art.label: Clip 1 art
clip1Art.description: The illustration that stands in when the step has no clip: solitaire, band, pendant, studs, hoops, tennis, diamond, watch or ringbox. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

ctaLine.label: Closing line
ctaLine.description: The line on the closing card: where to buy. "Shop now, link in bio" for a store, "See the new line in person" with a show, "DM your sales rep for pricing" for the trade. Empty removes it.
ctaLine.placeholder: See the new line in store and online

show1Name.label: Show 1
show1Name.description: The first show you will be at. Empty (the default) is the shop close; a name adds the show card to the closing card, and the show band under every clip.

show1Dates.label: Show 1 dates
show1Dates.description: As they should read. Empty removes them.

show1Place.label: Show 1 place
show1Place.description: The city or the venue. Empty removes it.

show1Booth.label: Show 1 booth
show1Booth.description: A number reads as "Booth 418"; a value that starts with a word ("Stand 2.1/501") stands as typed. Empty removes it.

show2Name.label: Show 2
show2Name.description: A second show. Empty (the default) draws one show; a second sits beside the first on a wide canvas, below it otherwise.

show2Dates.label: Show 2 dates
show2Dates.description: As they should read. Empty removes them.

show2Place.label: Show 2 place
show2Place.description: The city or the venue. Empty removes it.

show2Booth.label: Show 2 booth
show2Booth.description: A number reads as "Booth 418"; a value that starts with a word ("Stand 2.1/501") stands as typed. Empty removes it.

boothStrip.label: Show band
boothStrip.description: Run the first show (name, dates, booth) as a band in the accent under every clip, once Show 1 has a name.

clipFit.label: Clip fit
clipFit.description: One fit for every clip: cover (the default) crops each clip to fill its rect; contain shows all of it on the page colour - a square turntable spin on a story canvas keeps the whole piece.

metal.label: Metal tone
metal.description: The metal the bundled illustrations are drawn in: gold, rose, white or platinum. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

stone.label: Stone tone
stone.description: The stone the bundled illustrations are drawn with. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: ivory (warm paper, dark text: the default), noir (near-black, light text), velvet (deep blue, ivory text) or blush (rose paper, brown text). Background and Text override either half.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The brand colour as #rrggbb: the show band, the booth numbers, the rule on the closing card and the progress line.

background.label: Background
background.description: The page colour as #rrggbb, around the clips and on the closing card. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract (every line fits its box, nothing over the clip) and draw it over the frame.
